name: The Aether Hub
description: The vital aether distribution center the renegades hold.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Yahenni confirm an unusual flux of aether is being diverted from the Aether Hub to the Spire's reservoir.
timeline.quote: Miss Nissa and I have recently determined an unusual flux of aether being diverted to that particular reservoir from the Aether Hub.

timeline.summary: Chandra, sleepless and troubled, looks over Ghirapur from the Hub and misses her mother.
timeline.quote: Now she's back, somewhere up above me, just a little bit away.

timeline.summary: Gideon comforts Chandra, and they recall how they met and the Purifying Fire; Chandra confesses guilt over the Sanctum of Stars and asks for a hug.
timeline.quote: He's standing with arms wide, smiling.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
timeline.quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

timeline.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
timeline.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

timeline.summary: Gideon, torn, asks Nissa to keep Chandra safe and returns to the Hub's defenses.
Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
timeline.quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

pages_say.description: A hub diverting aether to the Spire's reservoir; the renegades plan to capture it.
The vital aether distribution center the renegades hold.
